description: Use this after you deploy a fix: diff two committed runs of the same site — added/fixed/regressed, per-run pass/fail totals, truncated change list. Both runs must already exist; for a single page that has not been re-audited, use audit_url with siteId instead (read-only, no audit run consumed). Requires the audit:read scope.
name: compare_audit_runs
title: Compare two audit runs
